-- R-520: 出入帳總額比介於 1.00-1.50(含兩端)通報
SELECT s.account_id, s.ratio
FROM (
    SELECT
        t.account_id,
        ROUND(
          CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(t.amount) FILTER (
                     WHERE t.op_code IN ('OP01','OP02','OP03')), 0) = 0
               THEN 0
               ELSE COALESCE(SUM(t.amount) FILTER (
                      WHERE t.op_code IN ('OP21','OP22','OP23')), 0)
                    / SUM(t.amount) FILTER (
                      WHERE t.op_code IN ('OP01','OP02','OP03'))
          END, 2) AS ratio
    FROM txn_log t
    WHERE t.rev_flag <> 'Y'
      AND t.tx_time >= :start_date AND t.tx_time < :end_date
    GROUP BY t.account_id
) s
WHERE s.ratio >= 1.00 AND s.ratio <= 1.50;

_golden.intent: 正向對照(R-520):除零依規格取 0、比率四捨五入至小數 2 位後再比門檻,邊界(恰 1.00 / 恰 1.50)含兩端。與 mr_411 成對。
